hook: Your Chrome browser hides a dinosaur game when you go offline.
title: Chrome Hides A Dinosaur Game Offline
description:
Chrome has a built-in dinosaur game that shows up when you have no internet. Turn off your data, open any page, and tap the dinosaur to play.

#Shorts #Chrome #Tech
comment_prompt: What's your best dino score? Type it

scenes.narration: Your Chrome browser hides a dinosaur game offline.
scenes.headline: HIDDEN DINO GAME

scenes.narration: First, turn off your mobile data and Wi-Fi.
scenes.headline: TURN OFF INTERNET

scenes.narration: Now open any page in Chrome.
scenes.headline: OPEN ANY PAGE

scenes.narration: You get the no internet screen.
scenes.headline: NO INTERNET SCREEN

scenes.narration: See the little dinosaur? Tap it.
scenes.headline: TAP THE DINOSAUR

scenes.narration: It starts running, and you tap to jump.
scenes.headline: TAP TO JUMP

scenes.narration: Dodge the cactuses and see how far you get.
scenes.headline: DODGE THE CACTUS

scenes.narration: Next time you're offline, play the dinosaur.
scenes.headline: OFFLINE? PLAY DINO
scenes.sub: Next: more things that sound fake
